room.name: bridge
itemPlus: Chair - The Captain's chair! Cushy. You push a couple of buttons on the panels next to it, but nothing happens.

Bomb - You’re poking around and find an odd item, and as you’re examining it, you slowly realize it’s an explosive— at least a decade old, but definitely still viable, still volatile, and now you’ve gone and touched it.

room.name: cabin
itemPlus: PhotoPlush - You're not sure what this is. There's some sort of gelatinous food and a picture next to it, but the meaning escapes you. Is it an offering? A snack? Strange decor?
CandyBox - The label shows that this is a box of candy. You open it, but the only thing inside is slime.
Flan - Gelatin on a fancy plate! You consider eating it but don't know how it got there. Can you even eat gelatin?
Grabber - A grabber thingamajig. What is this used for, and what is the puddle underneath it? Gross.
Dresser - A dresser. You try to open it but the drawers are held shut by some sort of glue-like goop. You don't think you'll be able to remove it.
Lamp - A spiky lamp sits atop a pointy wooden stand. You poke it - ouch! Blood wells up on your finger.

room.name: captain's quarters
itemPlus: Armoire - An armoire. Probably full of things that don't fit you, unless this does happen to be your room... Maybe you should check it out. Just for curiosity's sake.
Bed - Plush!
Desk - The desk has books and papers... Unfortunately, you can't read any of them.
Dresser - A dresser. There's nothing atop to look at, but you can stare into the rug instead.

Cabinet - A cabinet filled with odd curios. Through the glass, you can see doohickeys that whirr and spin, doodads that swing back and forth, thingamabobs that undulate in a sequence, and a pitch black vase-shaped void that you can't see so much as not see. You can't figure out how to open the cabinet to examine anything closer, though.

room.name: medbay
itemPlus: Posters - A poster of a cat..? Hang in there, baby!
Knickknacks - These shelves have a lot of seemingly non-medical items on them. Either the medbay doesn't get much traffic or patients spend their time in here bored.
JarCan - Shiny, shimmery, splendid! Was someone painting in here or something?
Sink - Keep your hands clean!
Microscope - You can't seem to see anything through it, no matter which eye you use.
Book - A medical book... It was left open on a recipe for remembering things.
Computer - A computer monitor. It should be able to turn on, but you don't see any way to do so.
Medbed - A standard-issue medical bed. You push a couple buttons and it turns on. You lie down on it.
Glasses - Sweet! A pair of tinted glasses, complete with extra eye lenses! These should fit you perfectly. You take them.

room.name: mess hall 1
itemPlus: CreepyPlant - A budding plant, although it sort of resembles a bat hugging a plant. You're a bit worried about what touching it would do.
Fizzy - A fizzy drink(?). Given that you don't know what this is, you should probably not drink it.
Fruit - This could be a watermelon, if a watermelon had innards that looked like a brain. Someone has scooped this one's meat out already.
Magma - Hot! Hot! Do not touch! Who leaves magma just lying around?
NotBacon - Some sort of meat strips. You wonder if it'd taste like bacon.
NotBrain - The meat of the not-watermelon fruit looks like a mushy brain. Why, you wonder, does it glow?
TouchDie - You don't know what these are, but you get the sense that they're very destructive.

room.name: mess hall 4
itemPlus: Bread - A loaf of moldy bread. A very small number of the ship's inhabitants supposedly go wild for fresh moldy bread.
Microwave - A microwave. Looks far more old-fashioned than anything in a spaceship should.
EyeDrop - I spy a crying eye.
Tree - A potted tree..? Why is this on the counter? Does someone on this ship eat trees?
Grass - A pot of normal grass. Apparently the artificial lighting in here is good enough for grass - who knew!
Plants - A nice little display of fruit. Several items on this blanket look like pastries, but they're hand-picked from trees on Pas-IJ2.
Candy - Someone left some candy here. You pop a piece in your mouth. Mmm, citrus.
Cascoons - Are these... cocoons of some sort? Or just weirdly shaped candy? You poke one but still aren't sure.

room.name: storage bay
itemPlus: NoReason - .
Bracelet - Aha! You've found the bracelet! You pick it up.
Kaboom - If you ever need a weapon of mass destruction (or a workplace violation), you know where to look.
Lunchbox - Someone's missing their lunch. You wonder how long this lunchbox has been here.
FaceVase - "My face doesn't look like that vase!" ...But does yours?
Shelves - You don't know how to read any of these labels. You decide not to poke through these containers.
Drawers - You don't know how to read any of these labels. You decide not to poke through these containers.
FlightLog - The ship's navigation system is so messed up that all the flight logs for the last ten years can be found in this one tiny drawer.
Scary - You don't know how to read this label. You decide not to poke through it.
Grass - This is a bucket of... grass? It doesn't look very friendly.
Medbed - A customized medbed, though you wonder whom it is customized for.
